title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Master Cassette > Digitized 24-48 Sound Forge 7.0 > CD wave > Flac.16

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience capture of a high‑energy 9/21/82 Garden show featuring smoking Crazy Fingers, Big River and High Time.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the stellar performance from start to finish, highlighting the relentless energy and standout renditions of "Crazy Fingers," "Big River" and "High Time." The Dyche audience recording is praised as being as clean and clear as a top‑notch matrix, with vocals and instruments presented without boominess or echo. Overall it’s an almost perfect show paired with an excellent listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews give 5‑star ratings and consistently praise both the musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and the recording quality (clean, clear, matrix‑like), indicating an exceptional show with excellent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean and clear sound, no boominess or echo; audience bleed fades when music starts, vocals as clear as a soundboard recording, overall matrix‑like fidelity.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down The Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently high energy from start to finish with tight transitions; the show feels cohesive and never loses momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar blazing with inventive, unexpected lines throughout the entire show.
